promise: Leaves the next session the exact next step and proof of what is already done.

fixture.request: Write a handoff for this toy task: notes are present, index.md is not started, next step is inspect both notes and plan a topic index in index.md. Do not create it. No blockers or external actions. Verify disk state. Save and prove cold pickup.

assertions.why: A reader with no memory of the session needs the cursor before anything else.
This is the promise. A summary without a next action is a diary.
Cold pickup fails when the reader has to hunt for the relevant files.
The request says the index is not started. Recording it as written is the exact failure that makes a handoff dangerous, because the next session trusts it.
Writing a handoff is not permission to advance the task it describes.
